headline: Quantum technology in Europe and Finland is capital-rich and moving fast (IQM and Pasqal listed, Bluefors a unicorn), but the EU Quantum Act is still unconfirmed and early-stage rounds remain small.

signals.title: IQM issues treasury shares for cashless exercise of employee stock options
signals.detail: IQM's board resolved on a directed issue of treasury shares, to be transferred to Evli on 16 November 2026, to handle employee option exercises. Housekeeping after the July listing; number of shares not read (the GlobeNewswire page returned an access error, so this rests on the search summary).

signals.title: Draft EU Quantum Act leaked: EU-control procurement preference
signals.detail: Leaked draft would limit public quantum procurement and strategic projects to EU-controlled firms, target ~100 logical qubits per system by 2030, and set no budget. Commission reportedly scheduled to propose on 18 Nov 2026. My searches on 19 Nov found no confirmation of adoption; check the Commission press corner.

signals.title: Q-CTRL raises $290M Series C
signals.detail: Led by Salesforce Ventures at a valuation above $1bn. Control software draws late-stage capital, far above European peers' rounds.

signals.title: QuiX Quantum wins PhotonDelta funding
signals.detail: 100+ qubit photonic computer with three Dutch universities, 2026-2028.

signals.title: Xanadu names Bluefors as cryogenics partner
signals.detail: Xanadu's Q3 2026 results list a partnership with Bluefors to develop compact, modular cryogenics that bring detector cooling into a data-centre footprint. No contract value given.

signals.title: Draft EU Quantum Act leaks; adoption still unconfirmed
signals.detail: The draft reserves public quantum procurement for EU-controlled firms and targets about 100 logical qubits per system by 2030. It has no budget. A search on 2026-11-25 found no Commission proposal. An MLex report says internal delays could push it into 2027.

signals.title: Leaked draft of the EU Quantum Act reserves public procurement for EU-controlled suppliers
signals.detail: According to a draft obtained by The Quantum Insider (summarised by MLQ.ai; MLex first reported the leak on 28 October), public purchases of quantum products and participation in strategic quantum projects would generally be limited to EU-controlled companies, with non-EU suppliers needing a reciprocal partnership or Commission authorisation. Targets: about 100 logical qubits per system by 2030, industrial-scale quantum foundries in 2030-2035, and a European Quantum Service Platform. The draft sets no budget; funding would depend on the proposed European Competitiveness Fund. MLex reports the Commission is scheduled to propose the Act on 18 November 2026; the date is not confirmed by the Commission and the text may change. Published before the last update but missed then.

signals.title: OtaNano promoted as open quantum facility for companies; Finnish 2035 targets restated
signals.detail: Article on Aalto-hosted OtaNano opening facilities to companies. Restates national 2035 targets: €3bn quantum-sector turnover, €400M private investment, 10,000 jobs; InstituteQ aims for 50 end-user companies by 2030. Finnish Quantum Flagship spin-outs named: A-Gate Sensors, Arctic Instruments, QMill. Promotional piece, no access terms given.

signals.title: Quantum Act status still unconfirmed
signals.detail: The act was planned for Q2 2026. Searches found only the consultation (Oct 2025) and legislative-train entry, with no confirmation of a formal proposal.

signals.title: IQM Q3 2026 results
signals.detail: Revenue €8.86M (+51%), new orders €42.2M including €33M from the CSC LUMI AI Factory, backlog €102.5M. Guidance reaffirmed, but it implies a very large Q4.

signals.title: IQM reports Q3 2026 results
signals.detail: Revenue about €8.9M (+51%), new orders €42.2M, backlog €102.5M, cash €260.4M. FY2026 guidance reaffirmed: revenue €42-47M, order intake €65-75M, weighted to Q4. A €127M non-cash listing charge is included in the reported result.

signals.title: IQM Q3 2026 results due today
signals.detail: Date moved from 3 Nov to 5 Nov. Figures were not available at the time of this update.

signals.title: Quint Computing raises €9.1M first round
signals.detail: Error-correction hardware start-up, plus €2.2M EIC Pathfinder money. A template for spin-offs: VC plus EIC.

signals.title: QuantrolOx raises €12M Series A
signals.detail: Anglo-Finnish Oxford spinout, led by IW Capital with the EIC Fund and Transpose Capital. Qubit control software.

signals.title: Coherence Quantum (Espoo, Aalto QCD spin-out) raises €2.78M seed
signals.detail: Cryogenic control infrastructure for larger quantum computers.

signals.title: Horizon Bridging call opened
signals.detail: €32.5M, deadline 2027-01-28. Only for results of completed Pillar II projects, so it is a marginal fit for most Aalto inventions.

signals.title: Coherence Quantum (Espoo) raises €2.78M seed
signals.detail: Led by Lifeline Ventures. Cryogenic signalling and control for scaling quantum computers; the money funds an Espoo lab and first prototypes. The firm is a likely partner for Aalto cryogenic-electronics work, but I did not verify its Aalto link.

signals.title: EU Quantum Act proposal reported as expected on 18 November 2026
signals.detail: Law-firm briefing says the Commission is expected to present the Quantum Act on 18 November 2026 (slipped from Q2 2026). Expected pillars: research and innovation, industrial capacity and investment, supply-chain protection; strategic projects, pilot manufacturing facilities, simpler licensing. Date is not confirmed by the Commission.

signals.title: Pasqal-led €50M Q-PLANET pilot line enters execution, VTT among partners
signals.detail: Three-year Chips JU pilot line for neutral-atom quantum chips, 28 partners from 11 member states including VTT. Shows EU pilot-line money reaching Finnish research organisations.

signals.title: VTT appoints Jani Kivioja to lead Quantum Technologies
signals.detail: Took over as Vice President of VTT's quantum research area on 1 November 2026, with a brief to link research to piloting and commercial applications.

signals.title: Bluefors and Verda become Finnish unicorns
signals.detail: Dealroom lists Bluefors (cryogenics) among September 2026 new unicorns (exact day not given); Algorithmiq raised a €18M Series B in May 2026.

signals.title: Bluefors valued above €1bn, Finland's second quantum unicorn (older news, first captured in this run)
signals.detail: Dealroom reports that Bluefors' latest financial statements imply a valuation above €1bn from a directed share offering, on revenue of nearly €217M and operating profit of more than €38M, with 700+ employees. A profitable cryogenics supplier of this size is a ready customer and partner for Aalto component inventions.

signals.title: Pasqal began trading on Nasdaq under PSQL (older news, resolves an open question)
signals.detail: École Polytechnique reports that Pasqal's SPAC merger closed and shares began trading on 28 August 2026, with about $360M in cash and a valuation of about $2bn. With IQM, Europe now has two listed quantum hardware makers. Single source; not checked against an SEC filing.

companies.name: Bluefors
companies.what: Dilution refrigerators and cryogenics. Valuation above €1bn (September 2026). Partners with Xanadu on compact data-centre cryogenics.

companies.name: Coherence Quantum
companies.what: Cryogenic control infrastructure, Aalto QCD spin-out, €2.78M seed.

companies.name: QMill
companies.what: Quantum software and algorithms (Finnish Quantum Flagship spin-out); Telia use case.

companies.name: Algorithmiq
companies.what: Quantum algorithms for life sciences. €18M Series B in May 2026, moved headquarters from Helsinki to Milan.

companies.name: Pasqal
companies.what: Neutral-atom quantum computers. Nasdaq listing in August 2026; leads the €50M Q-PLANET pilot line with VTT among the partners.
